story.title: The Slowest Killer on Europa
story.signature_move: It drifts like a falling leaf toward a shrimp, then snaps its pincer-gripping feet shut.
story.hybrid_look: With a narrow, leaf-thin body, a chameleon-shaped head, jellyfish eyes, pincer-gripping feet, and a tightly curled tail, its colour-shifting scales mix with a translucent texture as it sways like a leaf, taking one slow step at a time.
